title: 第79章 过寿宴的钱得平摊

第79章 过寿宴的钱得平摊-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

月底盘账。

赵素梅把账本摊开，一笔一笔算给林国强听。

七月份，营业二十六天。

总流水，五千八百多块。

去掉食材本钱、工钱、税费、杂项开支。

净利润，两千一百块。

这还没算供销社卤味柜台赚的钱。

林国强看着这个数，没说话。

赵素梅以为他不满意。

“国强，你是不是觉得少了？”

“不少。”林国强把账本合上，“下个月会更多。”

他站起来，走到门口。

月亮挂在中天，照得院子亮堂堂的。

两千一百块。

一个月。

前世他累死累活干一年，也攒不下这个数。

但这辈子，不够。

他将来还要在县城开店。

要让赵素梅和孩子们过更好的日子。

要赚更多的钱。

身后，赵素梅慢慢走过来，扶着他的胳膊。

“国强，咱现在这样，已经很好了。”

“还不够。”他握住她的手，“以后会更好。”

院子里，月光如水。

林静和林薇在屋里睡着了，呼吸均匀。

赵素梅靠在林国强肩上。

“国强，我觉得像做梦一样。”

“不是梦。”林国强说，“是咱自己挣来的。”

夜风吹过，带着后院菜地里的青草味儿。

赵素梅闭上眼睛。

不是梦。

是真的。

七月底，林海柱把三个儿子叫回了老宅。

六十大寿。

庄户人家，六十是道坎，得办。

林海柱坐在堂屋正中的椅子上，抽着旱烟。

林国伟、林国强、林国栋，三人依次坐在长条凳上。

李红霞在旁边纳鞋底，徐青青和周桂芳站在门口，竖着耳朵听。

“爹，您六十大寿，得好好办。”

林国伟先开口，“我寻思着，在国强那儿办。

他那饭店，镇上头一份，办酒席有面子。”

林国栋赶紧接话：“对对对，二哥那儿地方大，菜也好。

咱爹六十大寿，不能寒碜了。”

林国强坐在凳子上，没吭声。

林海柱看了他一眼：“老二，你说呢？”

Chapter 79: The money for the birthday banquet must be shared equally - "Reborn at 80, taking my wife and daughter to eat and drink after the family separation"

Monthly account.

Zhao Sumei spread out the account book and calculated each item for Lin Guoqiang.

In July, it is open for twenty-six days.

The total turnover is more than 5,800 yuan.

Eliminate the cost of ingredients, wages, taxes, and miscellaneous expenses.

Net profit, 2,100 yuan.

This does not include the money earned by the supply and marketing cooperative’s braised food counter.

Lin Guoqiang looked at this number and said nothing.

Zhao Sumei thought he was dissatisfied.

"Guoqiang, do you think it's missing?"

"Quite a few." Lin Guoqiang closed the ledger, "There will be more next month."

He stood up and walked to the door.

The moon hung in the sky, illuminating the yard.

Two thousand one hundred dollars.

One month.

In his previous life, he worked exhaustingly for a year and could not save this amount.

But this life is not enough.

He will also open a store in the county in the future.

Let Zhao Sumei and the children live a better life.

To make more money.

Behind him, Zhao Sumei slowly walked over and held his arm.

"Guoqiang, we are doing very well as we are now."

"It's not enough." He held her hand, "It will be better in the future."

In the yard, the moonlight is like water.

Lin Jing and Lin Wei fell asleep in the room, breathing evenly.

Zhao Sumei leaned on Lin Guoqiang's shoulder.

"Guoqiang, I feel like a dream."

"It's not a dream." Lin Guoqiang said, "We earned it ourselves."

The night wind blew through, carrying the smell of green grass from the vegetable patch in the backyard.

Zhao Sumei closed her eyes.

Not a dream.

It's true.

At the end of July, Lin Haizhu called his three sons back to his old home.

Sixtieth birthday.

As a banker, sixty is a hurdle and must be dealt with.

Lin Haizhu sat on a chair in the middle of the hall, smoking a cigarette.

Lin Guowei, Lin Guoqiang, and Lin Guodong sat on the long bench one after another.

Li Hongxia was collecting shoe soles nearby, while Xu Qingqing and Zhou Guifang stood at the door, listening with their ears pricked up.

"Dad, you have to celebrate your sixtieth birthday well."

Lin Guowei spoke first, "I'm thinking about it, let Guo Qiang do it.

His restaurant is the first in town, and hosting banquets is a prestige."

Lin Guodong quickly answered: "Yes, yes, second brother's place is big and the food is good.

It's my father's sixtieth birthday and he can't be miserable anymore."

Lin Guoqiang sat on the stool and said nothing.

Lin Haizhu glanced at him: "Second brother, what do you think?"
